rationale: KRP is sitting at 0.9% of its daily range — essentially pinned at the session low — with the last several candles showing near-zero movement and collapsing volume (866, 908, then a spike to 46k on a down-move, then back to ~2k), suggesting the selling impulse has stalled but no reversal momentum has emerged. Despite a strongly risk-on macro backdrop (SPY +4.86%, VIXY -14.68%), KRP is down sharply from its prior close and trading well below VWAP ($13.84) and the 9-EMA ($13.67), indicating sector-specific weakness that makes a long risky; meanwhile, with only 84 minutes to close and price already at the low with no continuation, a short entry here offers poor reward-to-risk given the compressed ATR and tight spread providing little room before forced liquidation.
